subject: Demo scheduling — calendar invite showing wrong time zone (needs corrected ICS)
messages:
From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +01:00
Subject: Demo with Redwood - Dec 6 at 10:00

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this — we'd like to book a 45-minute demo with the team on Monday, Dec 6. I've attached an invite (Northbridge-Redwood-demo.ics) and sent the event from our scheduling system. It says 10:00 AM local time for us (CET/GMT+1).

Attendees: Marcus Hale (PM), Lina Ortiz (Ops), Sofia Ivanova (Redwood)

If that slot works, please accept and we'll confirm. If not, we can do 14:00 CET same day.

Attachments: Northbridge-Redwood-demo.ics (text/calendar)

Northbridge Health
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo with Redwood - Dec 6 at 10:00

Hi Lina — thanks, appreciate you sending this. Quick heads-up: when I accepted the invite it appeared on my calendar as 09:00 (UTC) rather than 10:00 CET. Marcus saw the same on his side.

Could you confirm whether the invite was issued as UTC or CET? Sometimes forwarded .ics files strip the VTIMEZONE block and clients display a "floating" slot. If you can resend with an explicit timezone block (or create the event from within Google Calendar and invite our emails directly) that should fix it.

Happy to accept whichever slot you choose — we prefer 10:00 CET but can do the 14:00 CET fallback.

Thanks,
Sofia
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Fwd: Demo with Redwood - Dec 6 at 10:00 (calendar TZ mismatch)

Karthik / Marcus — quick FYI and proposed next steps. Lina sent an invite that our calendars rendered an hour earlier (shows 09:00 instead of 10:00 CET). Likely causes: 1) the ICS was exported without a VTIMEZONE block, or 2) the organizer's scheduler used UTC when tagging the event. I've attached a screenshot the customer forwarded (attached as original-invite.ics + screenshot).

Proposed action:
- Ask Lina to resend a corrected invite with a full VTIMEZONE section (or create it directly in Google Calendar and invite our Redwood emails).
- Offer two concrete slots to avoid back-and-forth: Dec 6, 10:00 CET or Dec 7, 14:00 CET.
- I'll ask the customer to reissue the invite and can accept once it's fixed. If they can't, we'll send a fresh calendar link from our side (we can produce an .ics with explicit TZ).

Do you want me to take the send/coordination or should AE/SE own it? Thinking I can handle, then loop in SE for the demo content.

— Sofia
From: Lina Ortiz <lina.ortiz@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:22:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Demo with Redwood - Dec 6 at 10:00 (calendar TZ mismatch)

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and sorry for the confusion. Our scheduling tool exported the first .ics incorrectly. I've recreated the event directly in Google Calendar and resent invites; attached is the fixed .ics (northbridge-demo-fixed.ics) and a short note in the event description confirming CET (GMT+1).

New event details:
- Dec 6, 2026
- 10:00 — 10:45 CET (GMT+1)
- Google Meet link included in the invite (visible in the calendar event)

If the invite still shows incorrectly on your side, please reply with a screenshot — sometimes company calendars anchor to UTC if the VTIMEZONE is missing. I attached the original .ics and a screenshot for reference.

Thanks again — see you on Dec 6.

Best,
Lina
Director of Operations
Northbridge Health
Attachments: northbridge-demo-fixed.ics (text/calendar), original-invite.ics (text/calendar), ics-tz-screenshot.png (image/png)
